articles.summary: STAMFORD, Conn. --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Apr. 16, 2026-- April 16, 2026 -- ITT Inc. (NYSE: ITT) will release its first quarter financial results and its 2026 outlook before the opening of the New York Stock Exchange on Wednesday, May 6, 2026. The company will hold a conference call at 8:30 a.m.
articles.title: ITT to Release 2026 First Quarter Results and 2026 Outlook on Wednesday, May 6
